name: Context menu
description: A menu that opens where you right-click, or from the keyboard with Shift+F10, with icons, shortcuts and submenus.

props.name: children
props.description: The area that opens the menu. Right-click, long-press, Shift+F10 or the Menu key on anything focused inside it.

props.name: menu
props.description: ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSection, ContextMenuSeparator and ContextMenuSubmenu elements.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the menu for assistive technology, e.g. "File actions".

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when an item is chosen, including items in submenus.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Leaves the browser's own context menu in place.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Items that cannot be chosen.

props.name: menuClassName
props.description: Classes for the floating surface, e.g. a width. It is at least 200 pixels wide.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper around the area. Also accepts every other div prop. The wrapper has data-open while its menu is open.

props.name: children
props.description: The label.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the item in onAction.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16 pixel icon before the label.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A key hint at the end of the row, e.g. "⌘D".

props.name: tone
props.description: Destructive paints the row camellia, with a camellia-soft highlight.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the item is chosen.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the item.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the item that opens the submenu.

props.name: children
props.description: The items in the submenu.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16 pixel icon before the label.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the item that opens the submenu.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds of hover before it opens. The right arrow key opens it at once.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the submenu.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the submenu. Defaults to the label when it is a string.

props.name: menuClassName
props.description: Classes for the submenu's floating surface.

props.name: title
props.description: A small heading over the group.

props.name: children
props.description: The items in the group.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Lets the items in this group be chosen. Chosen items show a dot (single) or a check (multiple).

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Chosen items in this group (controlled).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the chosen items change.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the hairline.
